name: baton
description: baton's marketplace: context handoff between Claude Code sessions, with a code-enforced size cap.

plugins.name: baton
plugins.description: A handoff that does not grow: whole rewrite, hard budget enforced by code, continue/memory modes and a freshness notice against git. Right before any compaction (idle, auto or /compact) it has the summarizer write the handoff. An optional terminal mod draws a band above the prompt and a pane with the handoff. English and Spanish.
